# NanoCode

> Experimental open circular visual codes for branded application ecosystems. Rust generator and image reader; C ABI and WebAssembly. MIT. Version 0.2.0.

Use when a product owns its scanner and wants a recognisable visual identity. Use standard QR for universal camera compatibility. Not Apple App Clip compatible. Not encryption or authentication.

## Facts
S: 8 bytes / 4 rings. M: 16 bytes / 6 rings. L: 24 bytes / 8 rings. XL: 40 bytes / 10 rings. UTF-8 byte counts. Hamming (13,8) + CRC32. Scanner accepts packed grayscale (32..2048 per dimension), all formats auto-detected. Logo safe square: ±0.18. Browser camera needs HTTPS and consent. Frames processed locally.

## Platform evidence
Local execution: macOS ARM64, Web/WASM. iOS ARM64 core built. Other platform adapters and CI jobs require successful build/device validation. Flutter FFI is native only; Flutter Web needs JS/WASM.
